summary: Retested the 4 issues from iteration 1. Backend regression: 11/11 pytest passed. Verified fixes in code and E2E via Playwright. Results — (1) _id/password_hash leak: FIXED (login, /auth/me, /products, /customers all clean). (2) 'Sesi telah habis' toast on /login: PARTIALLY FIXED — direct visit to /login now shows no toast, but visiting '/' unauthenticated still shows the toast before redirecting to /login (root->/login flow still leaks the toast). (3) 'Pilih Paket Basic' hidden for Pro tenant: NOT FIXED — the Basic upgrade button is still rendered for a Pro tenant on the Billing page. (4) Midtrans simulation upgrade → reload: FIXED — after 'GOPAY / QRIS Otomatis' the user is NOT logged out, tenant package updates to Pro, sidebar shows PAKET PRO, and WhatsApp module unlocks. Backend fix (JWT cookie fallback in get_current_user) makes window.location.reload() survive.

minor.issue: Still a single 1035-line file — should be split into feature modules for maintainability (auth, products, customers, transactions, billing, dashboard).

ui_bugs.issue: For a Pro tenant, 'Pilih Paket Basic' is still visible. The render condition `pkg.upgradeTo && !pkg.current` allows a downgrade button; it must also check that pkg is a real upgrade tier vs current (e.g., PLAN_ORDER[pkg.name] > PLAN_ORDER[currentSub.package]).

App.js line ~390 still calls /api/auth/me on mount without checking for a session_token cookie or Authorization header, so any unauthenticated visit to '/' or any protected route causes a 401 and fires the 'Sesi telah habis. Harap masuk kembali.' toast before redirecting to /login. Fix: only call /auth/me when a cookie/token exists; otherwise silently redirect to /login without a toast.

action_items: Hide 'Pilih Paket Basic' when currentSub.package === 'Pro' (only show truly-higher tiers as upgrades). Suggested: use a PACKAGE_RANK map and render the button only when rank[pkg.upgradeTo] > rank[currentSub.package].

In MainAppLayout useEffect, guard the /auth/me call: read document.cookie for 'session_token' or axios.defaults.headers.common.Authorization first; if neither exists, navigate('/login') without showing the error toast.
(Optional / carry-over) Split /app/backend/server.py (1035 lines) into feature modules.
critical_code_review_comments: Backend get_current_user JWT-cookie fallback (server.py:210-214) is the reason the Midtrans reload flow now survives — good fix, keep this path or, better, migrate to setting Authorization from cookie on frontend boot to avoid double auth paths.
BaseDocument now correctly excludes _id, and User excludes password_hash — verified via curl.

Frontend still calls window.location.reload() after Midtrans simulation; it works only because backend accepts JWT-as-cookie. Consider replacing reload() with a state refresh (fetchSubscription + fetchAuthMe) to avoid a full page bounce.
Login route no longer calls /auth/me directly (LoginPage doesn't mount MainAppLayout), but the toast still fires whenever a fresh user hits '/'.

success_rate.frontend: ~85% — 2 of 4 iteration-1 UI bugs fully fixed, 1 partial, 1 unfixed

context_for_next_testing_agent: Backend fixes (id/password_hash exclusion + JWT cookie fallback) verified. Remaining bugs are purely frontend in /app/frontend/src/App.js: (a) MainAppLayout useEffect ~L390 needs to skip /auth/me when no cookie/token to eliminate the 'Sesi telah habis' toast on root visits; (b) BillingPage packages render ~L2026 needs a rank-based check so Pro tenants don't see the Basic upgrade button. After fixes, re-run pytest and revisit '/' unauth + Billing on Pro tenant.
rca of the issue: 'Basic button visible for Pro': the packages array marks Basic with upgradeTo:'Basic' regardless of current package; render guard `pkg.upgradeTo && !pkg.current` only hides the button for the CURRENT tier, not lower tiers, so a Pro tenant still sees Basic as a selectable 'upgrade'. 'Sesi habis on /'': MainAppLayout useEffect fires axios.get('/api/auth/me') unconditionally on mount; when no session cookie exists the backend returns 401 and the catch handler calls toast.error('Sesi telah habis...') before navigating to /login. Mitigation for both is a small conditional render / early return.
